text_block_list.text:
Today is a magazine interview focusing on "Rivals."
Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet's photoshoot proceeds smoothly, and—

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's a wrap!
That concludes all filming for today!
Great work, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Good work, everybodee!
Thank you for your hard work~♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...*phew*, it's finally over.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Being stuck with you the ENTIRE time felt absolutely miserable, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-What're you staring at? If you have something to say, just spit it out already!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No matter when I see it,
your racing outfit is super frilly, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
What are you bringing that up for now...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, taking a good look at it again, it's pretty crazy.
How do you even run with all those frills fluttering around?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Are you mocking me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's not that,
it's just not really my taste.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Oh yeah, there's something I've been wondering about for a while now too~.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Is your racing outfit supposed to be sweltering
or breezy? Which one is it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Good catch!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! This racing gear
has it all, it's so freaking cool~!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: First, having lots of belts looks so cool, and even though it's leather, it's not heavy at all and super easy to run in, which is great!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And the crowning touch is getting the best of both cool and heat!
Expressing the two sides of me... kinda thing!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my running is sharper than ever...
I just can't stop... Heh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Don't you mean your idiocy is unstoppable?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you don't believe me, do you!?
Just look at how brilliantly cool & heat this racing outfit is!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I gotta make 'em learn their lesson somehow...!
choice_data_list: Let me show you a truly brilliant run!
Deciding a winner would be the quickest way, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice idea, Trainer!
Proving it in practice is the fastest way, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, watch me! I'm gonna burn my
absolutely flawless running right into your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm not really interested.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I mean, getting a power-up just by putting on an outfit
is kinda cool! Like a real superhero!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, I'm definitely shaving down my time today!
Trainer, keep your eyes on the stopwatch!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I wasn't listening... You really are a simpleton.

Dragged along by a high-spirited Vodka,
I ended up timing her on the track, but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
How's that, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You've got to be kidding... !?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, did you see that, Scarlet?!
I just broke my top speed record agaaain...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whew♪ Feeling good!
Guess I'll just breeze right through like this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Beating your personal best just through pure conviction, is that even a thing?
Nothing's scarier than a simpleminded fool."

"...Together with Daiwa Scarlet, who cursed under her breath while looking somewhat envious,
I watched over Vodka as she ran around in pure joy..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you mean you're challenging me!?
Could you please leave me out of this!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Scarlet's wearing her racing silks too, so they're gonna be comparing us for real, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just came up with a great way to settle this...!
Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, first up is a weightlifting match!
After that, we'll battle it out on the other machines too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I really don't wanna know, but I'll ask anyway.
Why the gym?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Now listen up. This is a contest between you and me to see who can show off their duality better.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Will it be cool-headed yet fiery-hot me,
or frilly yet hardcore you...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's settle once and for all whose gap moe is more amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You moooooron!!
Seriously, what kind of ridiculous nonsense is that?!
In the end, Vodka pushed her way through, and their showdown at the gym began—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeahhhh!
I win again!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, what's wrong, Scarlet?
You're pretty weak today, aren't ya!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: B-Because something like this—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are Scarlet and the others
doing all dressed up in their racing silks...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Who knows...?
Practicing for something...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to concentrate
with everyone staring at me like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Um, Scarlet-san.
Just what are you...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it's nothing at all~. Please don't pay
it any mind everyone, and forget it if you can☆

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...You two better
remember this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you see that look on her face?
Terrifying..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I forgot about that, but when it came to two-facedness,
she really took the crown..."

Vodka had won the game,
but lost the battle...
